case_scope: Conditional dry-soil mass transport, three bank-volume sources and three compacted-volume demands. No claim of actual soil classification or site suitability.

bank_volumes_m3.basis: Explicit arithmetic fixture, not taskbook measured volume

compacted_volumes_m3.basis: Explicit arithmetic fixture balanced by dry mass

bank_dry_density_kg_m3.basis: Hypothetical three natural packing states; not a laboratory report

compacted_dry_density_kg_m3.basis: Hypothetical common target state; no test certification

haul_rate_cny_per_m3_km.basis: Arithmetic pricing scenario under DEC-005/006; no contract

distance_km.basis: Declared scenario distances, not measured routes

material_assumptions.statement: Hypothetical mutually compatible material, natural density differs by packing state only; no soil-type classification asserted
Material may be mixed for this thought experiment and every destination has the explicitly stated target dry density
No removal/addition of dry solids, screening, haulage loss, borrow or disposal; water mass is outside the conserved dry-mass variable
All explicitly allowed routes are hypothetical and carry no claim of real access or materials compliance

independent_proof.type: Exact primal-dual certificate plus separate natural-volume HiGHS equations
